name: MegaMan's charge glow's place
why: MegaMan's buster charge glow (the fourth kind's type 8, spawned for him) follows him at his buster arm, an offset each game takes from its own table by his NameID: BN6's puts it 2 pixels further right. His presentation, not the family's code.
evidence: its place from the arm's: BN5 0x080E0F22-0x080E0F3A calls 0x08015140 / BN6 0x080E2218-0x080E2230 calls 0x08018810, each by the object's +0x28 (MegaMan's 0x180, 0x1A0)
